title: Property Lists and Data Formats knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: Replace a focused example with unrelated code.
The main goal is to apply property list serialization in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use property lists and data formats only for visual styling.
Skip type checking and accept any result.
questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply property list serialization in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Property Lists and Data Formats is best learned through a small, verifiable example. Serialization translates typed data to and from a format. Handle missing or malformed fields explicitly and plan for schema changes and compatibility.
